title: window_create uses window_shell but sessions_create uses window_command
description: Line 213 passes `window_shell=body.command` to `sess.new_window()`, but line 172 passes `window_command=body.command` to `server.new_session()`. The libtmux APIs differ: `new_session()` uses `window_command`, but `new_window()` may expect a different parameter. This inconsistency suggests one path is wrong - verify against libtmux docs which parameter is correct for each call.
